main_measure.name: forecast-weighted 20-bar excess return, block mean over non-overlapping 20-bar blocks
main_measure.threshold: confirm if block mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject if block mean < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; inconclusive if fewer than 50 blocks with a non-zero position

supporting_check.name: share of forecast>0 bars whose next 20-bar return beats 20 x pooled mean daily return, vs 50%

reading: Allocation is postRebalance_current_allocation, blocks are rows 0-19, 20-39, ... of each window summed over bars that have a 20-bar forward return, the t-statistic is taken over the blocks holding a non-zero position (the blocks the plan's minimum counts), and the supporting check passes when the share exceeds 50%.
